From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Subject: Launchpad: OKR draft and sign-off (Q2 planning)

Team —

Attached is the first-pass OKR "launchpad" for Q2. The goal here is to get leadership alignment on the top 6 priorities and the acceptance criteria so the org can start sprinting on measurable work next week. High-level asks: review scope, call out any blockers (resourcing, SLAs, dependencies), and either mark as SIGN-OFF or propose concrete edits by EOD Wednesday.

Key notes up top:
- Focus must be on latency & cost per token improvements, customer reliability (SLOs), and two new managed features for Dedicated (autoscale + burst).
- I added an explicit metric for "cost per 1k tokens" and a canary for production regressions.
- Blockers: needs confirmation on the hiring plan for two infra engineers and one product manager — Vivek, can you confirm headcount?

Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/OKR-Launchpad-DRAFT
Attachment: [Attachment: OKR-Launchpad-DRAFT.gdoc (Google Doc link)]

If we can get sign-off from execs by Thursday, we can lock the QBR narrative and send to marketing for the customer-facing deck.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Product, Redwood Inference

Thanks Karthik — skimmed and left comments in the doc. A couple quick items I think we should tighten before sign-off:
- Objective language: make the customer impact first ("Reduce latency for synchronous API by 25% for p95" vs purely infra phrasing).
- Quarterly milestone: move the rollout of dedicated autoscale to the "stretch" column, since ops wants an extra safety window.
- Add a line for legal/compliance to validate data retention footnotes for Private customers.

I'll add inline suggestions in the doc. Short on time this morning but can join a quick sync at 2pm if helpful.

Appreciate the draft. A few operational items that need clarity before I can sign off:
1) Hiring: the two infra hires and PM — we have headcount budgeted but not yet approved for Q2 ramp. I'll escalate to finance today but need a fallback plan if hires are delayed by 6-8 weeks. Suggest we include a contingency (contractor budget + partnering with infra team) as a sub-item under the objective.
2) SLA targets: the p95/p99 numbers look aggressive for Dedicated customers. Can we include a phased target (canary -> 1st wave -> GA)?
3) Cost metric: define whether cost per 1k tokens includes cache savings and pre-quantization numbers. Otherwise different teams will measure differently.

I can join the 2pm sync. Also tagging Evelyn for QBR narrative alignment.

VP, Engineering Ops

- Final doc attached (PDF) for archival and exec distribution.
